_comment: Words a 3–5 year old in Hindi/Hinglish is unlikely to have (or that name an adult idea). The compiler warns when a line spoken TO the child uses one. Add to it as the kids teach you; 'why' is for the writer, 'use' is the suggestion. Matching is whole-word, case-insensitive, on the line text.

overflow.why: not a picture; a spilling glass is

fuel.why: the card says पेट्रोल; nobody says fuel to a child

flashlight.why: American; kids and the card say टॉर्च

wing.why: English; पंख is the child's word

चोंच.why: rare word; 'मुँह सूख गया' or 'प्यास लगी' is lived

mission.why: adult word (tolerated once, in the water break)

रोशनी.why: kids say light; रोशनी is a speed bump every time (Dilpesh, 30 Sep)

शुक्रिया.why: the animals already say thank you

मड.why: one word for mud, the one they say

पट्टी.why: kids say band-aid (Dilpesh, 30 Sep); feminine: बैंड-एड लग गई

idioms.बत्ती गुल: an idiom — keep only while the kids react to it
idioms.ये कौन करता है: Coco's signature line — fine, it is a running sound not an idea
idioms.चूहे दौड़ रहे: an idiom dressed as a joke — watch whether the kids get it
idioms.मड्डी गड्ढा: kept on purpose (Dilpesh): 'मड्डी गड्ढा' stays; plain mud is कीचड़
